_comment: Hand-maintained corrections applied on top of the scraped fusion-properties.json.
Use this when the game disagrees with the wiki, or the wiki lags behind a game update.
Each entry is a partial patch keyed by shard id. Keys starting with '_' are ignored,
so '_name' is free to use as a human-readable label.
'fuse_amount' may also be overridden directly even though it isn't a scraped field.
While any override is present, the wiki drift assertions in build-properties.py
report as warnings instead of failing the build.

U79._source: 0.27 patch notes: recipe changed from Ant + Elusive Family to Ant + Queen Bee

E12._source: 0.27 patch notes: no longer has a Special Fusion recipe, obtainable via Generic Fusion only

U65._source: Confirmed by an admin: 5x is a known bug, will eventually be fixed to the correct 2x (Frog family)
